name: Fahd of Saudi Arabia
role: King of Saudi Arabia from 1982 to 2005
contribution: King and Prime Minister of Saudi Arabia from 13 June 1982 until his death in 2005.
legacy: He is credited for having introduced the Basic Law of this person in 1992

checks.lead: Fahd bin Abdulaziz Al Saud (1920, 1921 or 1923 – 1 August 2005) was King and Prime Minister of Saudi Arabia from 13 June 1982 until his death in 2005. Prior to his ascension, he was Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia from 1975 to 1982.
